title: Tower projection and its counit transpose commute with ground-field retagging
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0$ of characteristic $p$, an algebraic closure $k$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with ring of integers $\mathcal O_E$; put $A_n=\mathcal O_E/\ell^n$ for $n\geq1$ [def-pur-conventions, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes, and $f:X\to Y$ a smooth separated $k$-morphism of pure relative dimension $d\geq0$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. For a field automorphism $\sigma:k\simeq k$ fixing $k_0$, let $T^\sigma$ be the same scheme $T$ with structural map $\operatorname{Spec}(\sigma)\circ a_T$, for $T=X,Y$, and let $f^\sigma$ be the same underlying morphism. Use the strict varying-coefficient tower categories $\operatorname{Tow}(T,\mathcal O_E)$ [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers], their ordinary derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and their full subcategories $\mathcal C_T=\Dctf(T_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal O_E/\ell^\bullet)$ of towers with constructible levels and level-independent finite cohomological and Tor bounds [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers].

Identify the underlying tower operations, twists and same-compactification functor $F$ as in [lem-pur-tower-operations-ground-field-retagging]. Let $G$ and $G^\sigma$ be the right adjoints of $F$ for $f$ and $f^\sigma$ on $\mathcal C_Y$, with counits $\varepsilon$ and $\varepsilon^\sigma$ [det-sp-tower-gluing], and let $\rho:G^\sigma\xrightarrow{\sim}G$ be the unique natural isomorphism with $\varepsilon_K\circ F(\rho_K)=\varepsilon^\sigma_K$. Denote the coefficient-unit tower on $Y$ by $\mathbf1_Y$, and put $\omega=G\mathbf1_Y$ and $\omega^\sigma=G^\sigma\mathbf1_Y$. For $M\in\mathcal C_X$ and $K\in\mathcal C_Y$, the compactification projection transformations
$$\mathrm{PF}_{M,K}:FM\otimes^LK\longrightarrow F(M\otimes^Lf^*K)$$
for $f$ and $f^\sigma$ are the same natural transformation in the ordinary tower derived category. Here projection means the proper direct-image mate of the pullback-tensor comparison followed by its ordinary counit, then the extension-by-zero tensor comparison [def-exchange-projection, det-sp-tower-shriek-levels].

For $K\in\mathcal C_Y$ let $C_K:F(f^*K\otimes^L\omega)\to K$ be the inverse-projection composite, with tensor symmetry and unit constraints, followed by $1_K\otimes\varepsilon_{\mathbf1_Y}$, and define $C_K^\sigma$ using $G^\sigma,\varepsilon^\sigma,\omega^\sigma$. Let $t_K:f^*K\otimes^L\omega\to GK$ and $t_K^\sigma:f^*K\otimes^L\omega^\sigma\to G^\sigma K$ be their adjoint transposes [det-sp-tower-gamma](2). Then
$$C_K\circ F(1_{f^*K}\otimes\rho_{\mathbf1_Y})=C_K^\sigma,$$
$$t_K\circ(1_{f^*K}\otimes\rho_{\mathbf1_Y})=\rho_K\circ t_K^\sigma.$$
These are equalities of morphisms in the ordinary derived categories of strict towers, including their quotient-coefficient transitions, for every $K\in\mathcal C_Y$, without a normalization hypothesis. No orientation map is assumed or compared in these assertions.

source.place: Clause (2), projection-formula/counit transpose; explicit retagging comparison for thm-pur-weil-equivariance-of-purity-and-trace, proof Steps 1–3

proof.text: Ground-field retagging retains the compactification record definitionally. Thus its specified projection at each M,K is literally the original projection. This proves the first conjunct by reflexivity without using the operation-retagging theorem.

Apply lem-sp-tower-tensor-adjoint-domains separately to the given G and G_sigma. Retain the tensor models from the first application; unit membership is a proposition, so the two witnesses define the same unit object. This supplies hQ, hQ_sigma, hpf and hpf_sigma for every K without assuming any comparison equation.

Prove naturality in the first tensor variable of the actual compactification projection. For the proper projection use naturality of the pullback tensor comparison and counit, followed by naturality of homEquiv. For openTensor apply injectivity of the open adjunction homEquiv to its inverse and use its prescribed mate formula. Compose with pullback composition. Invert the resulting projection square. Naturality of the source and target signed braidings then gives naturality of the inverse-projection/symmetry word.

Mathlib rightAdjointUniq_hom_app_counit states the counit-preserving property of rho. Transport it through the actual section realization using naturality of supportRealization.inv. Follow the preceding inverse-projection equation by identity tensor this counit and the unit identification, then by the right unitor. Tensor functoriality gives F(tensorComparison) followed by projectionCounit = projectionCounit_sigma.

For the transpose equation, lift the source comparison using fullness of the realization. Naturality of supportRealization and the preceding projectionCounit equation identify the original full-subcategory projection composites. Apply the adjunction Hom equivalence and the counit-preserving rightAdjointUniq relation. Map the equality forward through realization and cancel the realization counit isomorphisms. This is exactly the definition of tensorMate, so it proves the ambient comparison without any faithfulness assumption on finite evaluation.
